newsitem.title: FRANCE: Liberte/TAT chrmn vows to stand up to strike.
newsitem.headline: Liberte/TAT chrmn vows to stand up to strike.

text.p: Marc Rochet, chairman of British Airways units Air Liberte/TAT said in an interview to be published on Sunday he would not give in to demands for more pay from pilots and technicians who plan a 48-hour strike from Wednesday.
"We have calculated that if we agree to their demands our wage costs would rise by 18 percent," Rochet told the weekly Journal du Dimanche. "It is out of the question."
"This strike will not make me change my mind. Anyway, I don't think it will be very well supported.
Air Liberte and TAT are in the process of merging after the European Commission said on February 28 that it had cleared British Airways' proposed acquisition of the insolvent Air Liberte.
